defect: FIFO full comparison consumes the read pointer directly in the write clock domain

mutation.description: The write-side full equation compares write_ptr with read_ptr_async instead of a safely synchronised Gray pointer.

rationale: Read pointer bits can change near a write clock edge and create a false-full or false-not-full result, allowing overflow or needless blockage.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Unsynchronized multi-bit remote pointer directly controls write-side full status.
